requirements.description: Synchronous reset clears every accumulator, the shared index, running and done
The engine stays idle until start is pulsed, then streams from index 0
Each MAC accumulator equals the 32-bit wraparound dot product of its weight bank and the activation stream
done asserts after NW activations and stays asserted while the engine is halted
A second streaming run with fresh weights and activations produces correct results
A partial stream (act_valid deasserted mid-stream, then resumed) still completes correctly
Reset clears all accumulators and done after a completed run
